items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: Of course, Kid Rene and Petit and all those fellows were around at that time too. They were no slouches either.

ctx.x: Well, the records show that with Al. That's right. Well, Padron and Bowman both come through good. Yeah, that's right.
Of course, Kid Rene and Petit and all those fellows were around at that time too. They were no slouches either. You remember them?
